info.name: IFRIC Registry Service
info.description:
Generated from backend/openapi.yaml (ifric-registry-service-oss).

Set `baseUrl`, then run Auth > "Auth Controller log In" — its test script stores access_token into the `bearerToken` collection variable, which every other request inherits. `companyCreationApiKey` is only needed by POST /company/create-company (X-API-Key, not a bearer token).

Regenerate the spec with `npm run generate:openapi` from backend/ against a running app.
